title: Fatima Masumeh Shrine
geometryBasis: The Qom shrine core uses the original named area 1443636758, built envelope 1462664905 and Atabaki court outline 245086022 in Mirror Court relation 3359977. The visible golden dome is centered at the published object coordinate. The reconstructed Atiq enclosure, iwan faces and minaret positions are component estimates from the 2009 photographs and written relationships.
sectionBasis: The 2009 originals show the restored high gilded drum and bulbous dome, north gold lanterns, taller tiled Mirror Iwan minarets and the smaller eastern entrance pair. The Oxford archival research describes an octagonal transition and an approximately 16-meter rise above the roof before the documented regilding. Use a comparable roof-to-dome rise for the photographed 2009 profile, with approximate finial heights. The provider terrain rises into the historic core and slopes across the eastern court.
limitations: Dome height and section, internal Atiq court alignment, iwan details and exact tower placements are visual estimates. The 2009 photographs establish the appearance and size hierarchy.
The named modern map fixes the overall footprint and the Atabaki court. Its tomb point differs from the published dome coordinate by about 22 meters, so the visible dome uses the latter.
The original 256-meter provider field remains unchanged. The relief includes probable rooftop and canopy influence, so approaches, foundation exposure and thresholds are approximate.
This is the historic shrine exterior with the two central courts. Adjacent Azam Mosque, modern outer halls and interiors are outside scope.
